description: In every arithmetic structure \(M\), the standard copy contains \(0^M\) and is closed under \(S^M\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.standard_copy_closed.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∈ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.standardCopy M ∧
    ∀ a ∈ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.standardCopy M,
      Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M a ∈ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.standardCopy M
